sentences.text: Govt. Of Nct Of Delhi vs Gajinder on 10 February, 2023

Bench: M.R. Shah, C.T. Ravikumar
 Item No.18 Court No.4 Section Xi
 S U P R E M E C O U R T O F I N D I A
 Record Of Proceedings
 Special Leave Petition (Civil) Diary No(s). 3459/2023
 (Arising out of impugned final judgment and order dated 30-11-2017
 in Wp(C) No. 12149/2015 passed by the High Court Of Delhi at New
 Delhi)
 Govt. Of Nct Of Delhi & Anr. Petitione
 Versus
 Gajinder & Anr. Responden
 (For Admission and I.R. and Ia No.20774/2023-CONDONATION Of Delay
 In Filing )
 Date : 10-02-2023
This petition was called on for hearing today.

Coram :
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice M.R. Shah
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice C.T. Ravikumar

For Petitioner(s) Ms. Astha Tyagi, AOR  Mr. Dinesh Chander Trehan, Adv.
 Ms. Diksha Narula, Adv.
 For Respondent(s)

UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners has vehemently submitted that in the present case, the possession of the land in question has been taken over.

It is submitted that even an objection was raised before the High Court on the maintainability of writ petition at the instance of the original writ petitioner(s) and the High Court has not considered the locus of the original writ petitioner(s).

It is submitted that in any case as the possession of the land in question was taken, in view of the decision of the Constitution Bench of this Court Indore Development Authority vs.
Manoharlal and Others, (2020) 8 SCC 129, there shall not be any deemed lapse under Section 24 (2)
of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013. 12:35:06 IST Reason:
contd..
Govt. Of Nct Of Delhi vs Gajinder on 10 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181293179/
1 - 2 - Issue notice on the application(s) for condonation of delay as well as on the Special Leave Petition, making it returnable on 27.03.2023.
